secrets.name: RESEND_API_KEY
secrets.description: Resend API key for sending verification emails during signup. Optional — without it the app prints the verification code to the server console instead of emailing it.

secrets.name: STRIPE_SECRET_KEY
secrets.description: Stripe secret key for the payment-setup step of signup. Optional — without it the payment step reports honestly that no processor is connected rather than pretending to collect a card.
